text:
Jordan: Hey infra team — first day here. Trying to run my branch CI and the Buildkite pipeline 'deploy-staging' fails instantly with an ECR push 403. Anyone know who to ping for Buildkite/GH App perms?
Eli: Welcome! Can you paste the root error and the repo?
Jordan: Repo: redwood/service-payments
Jordan: Error snippet: ```ECR auth error: denied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/buildkite-agent is not authorized to perform: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken```
buildkite-bot: Build #4827 failed: https://buildkite.com/redwood/service-payments/builds/4827 — status: failed
Samira: Likely the GH org app or repo Packages permission. New hires often miss the 'ci-runners' team. @Eli can you check the org app scopes and team membership?
Eli: On it. Jordan, looks like you don't have Packages/Write on that repo. I can add you to the ci-runners team; give me a minute.
Zoe (eng-infra): Also note we rotated ECR credentials last week — some repos still need the updated secret in GH Actions/Buildkite env. Worth checking the repo-level secrets after membership.
ci-ops: Quick workaround if you have local creds: ```aws ecr get-login-password --region us-west-2 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com``` then `docker push` with your branch tag. But only do this if you have ECR permissions.
Jordan: I tried that and got 403 on get-login-password. I don't have permissions yet.
Eli: Okay I added you to the 'ci-runners' team and re-ran the pipeline. Retrying build now.
buildkite-bot: Build #4828 queued by Eli — https://buildkite.com/redwood/service-payments/builds/4828
buildkite-bot: Build #4828 passed ✅
Jordan: Amazing, that fixed it — thanks everyone!! super quick. :heart: 
Samira: Welcome aboard :tada: If anything similar pops up, ping #eng-infra or DM me. We'll add a short note to onboarding docs about the ci-runners step.
Zoe (eng-infra): I'll add an onboarding checklist item about verifying repo Packages access and the rotated ECR secret.
Jordan: Noted. Closing thread — thanks!
